The '''CAAF-2 system cybernetic avionics interface''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant produced by [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It allowed its user to be connected directly to the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] or an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]].
